about: Plans the production and re-checks the script after the story editor.

provides.briefing:
Re-run both linters on the punched-up script, because the story editor changed it after it was fact-checked. A hook that outran its sources is caught here or never. Write the combined result to meta/lint_report.json -- a stage that emits nothing can only be claimed, never verified:
  python3 <screenwriter>/scripts/scriptcheck.py script.md --json > /tmp/a.json
  python3 <story-editor>/scripts/hookcheck.py script.md --json > /tmp/b.json
then merge them as {"scriptcheck": <a>, "hookcheck": <b>}. Both must report zero errors before advancing.
